name: Ad On Group
description: Ad On Group — marketing, workforce, digital and on-hold services.
//logoFooter: White-on-transparent lockup for the dark footer. The main logo is a JPEG on solid white; the footer used to fake a white version with filter:brightness(0) invert(1), which needs transparency to work — on an opaque JPEG it turned the whole box into a solid white rectangle on every page.

thirdParty.//: Toggle 3rd-party embeds on/off from one place. Wired up in the FINAL step.
thirdParty.//formEndpoint: The main contact form stays on Formspree, deliberately. Its enquiries are read and replied to in an inbox, which is what Formspree is good at, and it has worked for months. Only the quiz moved to /api/lead: fourteen fields per submission belong in spreadsheet columns, not an email.
thirdParty.//forms: Forms beyond the main contact form, keyed by the value of a form's data-form attribute. A form whose key is empty stays deliberately inert rather than posting nowhere and looking like it worked. A key pointed at /api/lead lands in the Google Sheet, in a tab named after the key, so forms stay separated without separate endpoints.
